nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Central barrel export for the entire Jotai state store, re-exporting session, project, search, platform, settings, git, and other atom module slices plus SessionCore types and hooks.
nodes.languageNotes: Session types/hooks are re-exported via direct paths rather than through the session barrel to avoid a circular dependency.

nodes.name: autoUpdateAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Settings-backed Jotai atom exposing the auto-update toggle, reading and writing the general.autoUpdateEnabled key via the shared settings atom.

nodes.name: devModeAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Persisted boolean atom controlling developer mode, backed by localStorage via jotai's atomWithStorage.

nodes.name: gitDependencyAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks whether the git binary is installed on the host system, probing the Rust backend via the detect_git_dependency command and caching the result in an atom.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel export re-exporting the dev-mode toggle and system dependency scan atoms for the platform store slice.

nodes.name: preventSleepAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Settings-backed atom for the 'prevent system sleep while an agent session is running' preference, persisted to settings.jsonc.

nodes.name: systemDepsAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Lazy-loading atom set that fetches cached or freshly-scanned system dependency status from the Rust backend and exposes a binary-name-to-installed lookup map.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a cache-then-scan fallback strategy with private internal atoms (rawDepsAtom, depsLoadedAtom, depsLoadingAtom) guarding a single public write-only loader atom.

nodes.name: updateChannelAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Persisted update-channel preference atom (auto/stable/beta) plus a pure resolver function mapping 'auto' to the concrete channel based on the running build's version string.

nodes.name: voiceInputAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Settings-backed toggle atom controlling whether the voice input microphone button and push-to-talk shortcut are enabled in composer toolbars.

nodes.name: allProjectsAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Manages the 'All Projects' aggregate list-entry atom used by the sidebar's virtual all-projects view, with derived flattened-list and loading atoms.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel export re-exporting the project, all-projects, and project-git-folder-sync atoms for the project store slice.

nodes.name: projectAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Core project state store holding the project list plus filter/search state, and deriving selected/filtered projects, status grouping, counts, and aggregate stats.

nodes.name: projectGitFolderSyncAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks per-organization results of syncing a project's git folder, keyed by org id.

nodes.name: codeSearchIndexAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Manages code-search indexing state across repositories: which repos are indexed, in-progress indexing sets, last-updated timestamps, and a currently-inert indexing queue.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel export re-exporting the code search indexing atoms for the search store slice.

nodes.name: adeManagerPaletteAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Holds transient state for the ADE (Agent Dispatch Engine) Manager command-palette run, including draft text, run status, and a pending session proposal.

nodes.name: agentRegistryAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Global registry atom holding CLI agent and API provider metadata fetched from the Rust backend, the single source of truth for agent/provider compatibility.

nodes.name: canvasPreviewAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Stores the latest inline canvas payload emitted by an agent via render_inline_canvas, with pure helper functions to derive, dismiss, and clear per-session canvas snapshots.

nodes.name: cliAgentVisibilityAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Persists per-agent visibility overrides for the CLI agent picker, with a pure helper resolving effective visibility from install status and user overrides.

nodes.name: cliSessionStatusAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks the UI-effective runtime status of the active session (running/idle/error), including stream-retry state, context-token usage breakdown, cancel/rollback flags, and a session-scoped write gate that prevents cross-session status bleed.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses module-level mutable registration functions (registerRuntimeStatusGateSessionAtoms, registerLiveSubagentSignalAtom) to inject cross-module atom references at runtime and avoid import cycles.

nodes.name: creatorDefaultExecModeAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Persists the SessionCreator's default agent execution mode to localStorage, migrating the legacy 'explore' value to 'ask' on read, used only as a pre-fill fallback before a session record exists.

nodes.name: creatorDefaultTuiModeAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Persists the SessionCreator's default TUI mode preference to localStorage, used to seed new CLI agent sessions at launch time.

nodes.name: creatorDraftAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Manages pre-launch SessionCreator drafts (text, name, attachments) persisted to localStorage, with atoms to create/select/promote/delete drafts and helpers to generate ids, save, and check emptiness.

nodes.name: cursorIdeTurnSummariesAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Per-session atom family holding Cursor IDE external-history turn summaries, keyed by session id.

nodes.name: fileReviewAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks review state (pending/kept/undone) of file changes made by the coding agent per session, including batch registration, keep/undo-all actions, pending counts, revert snapshot anchors, and per-file accept/reject resolutions.

nodes.name: resolveUpdateChannel
nodes.summary: Resolves the 'auto' update-channel preference to a concrete channel by checking whether the current version string contains a semver prerelease marker.

nodes.name: deriveCanvasForSessionSnapshot
nodes.summary: Derives a session-scoped canvas snapshot (latest payload, visible payload, dismissed/opened flags) from the shared canvas preview entry, returning nulls when the entry doesn't match the given session.

nodes.name: dismissCanvasForSession
nodes.summary: Marks the canvas entry as dismissed for a matching session id, leaving non-matching or already-dismissed entries untouched.

nodes.name: clearCanvasForSession
nodes.summary: Clears the canvas entry when it belongs to the given session id, otherwise returns it unchanged.

nodes.name: isCliAgentEnabled
nodes.summary: Resolves whether a CLI agent should be visible, preferring a user override and falling back to the agent's installed status.

nodes.name: registerRuntimeStatusGateSessionAtoms
nodes.summary: Registers the list of session-id atoms that define the 'visible session' gate, called once by viewAtom.ts at module load to avoid an import cycle.

nodes.name: registerLiveSubagentSignalAtom
nodes.summary: Registers an externally-owned boolean atom signaling whether a background subagent is still active, injected by viewAtom.ts to avoid an import cycle.

nodes.name: saveDraft
nodes.summary: Stamps a draft with an id (generating one if absent) and created/updated/saved timestamps, returning a complete SessionCreatorDraft ready to persist.

nodes.name: isDraftEmpty
nodes.summary: Checks whether a session creator draft has no name, editor content, or uploaded files.
